state_cases.name: pending-recovery-after-restart
state_cases.expect: Reuse persisted original keys, bind returned device, save link/history atomically; never reuse code.

state_cases.name: completed-link-never-recovers
state_cases.expect: No recovery request; preserve pinned trust and use refresh.

state_cases.name: lock-or-stale-trust-revision
state_cases.expect: Cancel pending result; no partial keys/notices/history/document-result mutation.

state_cases.name: unsigned-notice-durability
state_cases.expect: Persist root and accepted descendant fingerprints with plain notice/history before trust can produce Verified; no acknowledgment gate.

state_cases.name: cross-origin-redirect
state_cases.expect: No follow-up request and no completed link.

state_cases.name: remove-during-recovery
state_cases.expect: Fresh account then device lock/recheck gives removed403 if removal committed first; never resurrect.

state_cases.name: first-publish-concurrency
state_cases.expect: Stable clinic mutex precedes full proof/graph/count validation even when inventory was empty.
